decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint builds directly on the firm's core knowledge of pipe and valve metal fabrication, and its move from a mention to its own page signals growing commitment that the firm can interpret and improve upon.

The powder-coated public waste bin uses the firm's existing sheet-metal and coating skills, giving enough related knowledge to assimilate market feedback, though it is a step away from the piping core.
As a close variant of the waste bin it shares the same fabrication and coating base, so the firm can apply its learning across the line at low extra cost.

Outdoor ashtrays belong to the same street-furniture family and use known metalworking techniques, but they are a narrower niche with weaker ties to the firm's established knowledge, which makes them somewhat more vulnerable.
